sources.title: gpt-neo-2.7B · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: GPT-Neo 2.7B is a transformer model designed using EleutherAI's replication of the GPT-3 architecture. GPT-Neo refers to the class of models, while 2.7B represents the number of parameters of this particular pre-trained model.

sources.title: gpt-neo-2.7B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The model was released in March 2021. EleutherAI continues releasing larger models like gpt-neox-20b, though gpt-neo-2.7B itself receives no active updates. It remains functional and widely used for research and prototyping. This summary was produced with help from an AI and may contain inaccuracies—check the original source!

sources.title: GPT-Neo 2.7B: Private AI for Ops Automation - llm.co
sources.snippet: Open-Weight LLM · Private & Custom AI gpt-neo-2.7B A 2.7B parameter open-weight GPT-style model for companies building private text-generation pipelines and operational AI agents without external API dependencies. GPT-Neo 2.7B is a 2021-vintage transformer trained on the Pile dataset, designed as an open alternative to GPT-3 Ada. For ops teams, it's a fully permissive, self-hostable baseline ...
